slots.purpose: Hero and social share image: New Zealand's lakes and alpine scenery, signalling a luxury, landscape-led wedding ahead of a practical legal guide.
slots.shot_brief: Landscape 16:9, at least 2000px wide. A lakeside or alpine setting in New Zealand (for example the Queenstown or Wanaka area): an elegant, understated ceremony set-up (arch or aisle, natural florals) on a lawn or lake edge with mountains behind, golden hour. No people needed; a distant consented couple is acceptable. No venue named in copy or caption until 03-source-pack confirms one. Location proven by media kit, register row or EXIF, never by appearance. People only from a licensed real wedding with written couple consent (and guest or celebrant consent if identifiable) recorded in library-index.csv; never AI people, never stock models presented as a real couple. Source order: venue or lodge media kit with written permission (Gmail draft request, never sent by an agent); Tourism New Zealand media library only if its licence covers third-party commercial blog use ([[VERIFY licence]]: its terms may limit use to promoting travel to New Zealand, require a credit and set an expiry; record all of this in library-index.csv before any download); licensed premium stock bought by a human and added to the register. Never AI, never a competitor, directory, planner, photographer-blog or search-result image.
